bio: Focused on robotics research during university, I joined SoftBank Corp. in 2020 after completing my master's degree. Over 4 years I worked on enterprise systems and big data infrastructure, while also supporting robotics development through the company's internal side-project program. I later transferred to the "Axross" AI/DX talent development platform, working broadly as a product engineer, training instructor, and content lead. Actively participating in hackathons, I accumulated awards and was recognized as a high-market-value talent within the company. Since February 2026, following a 2-month FDE training program in India, I now work across FDE development & promotion, internal certified instructor, and content creation.
